# Beacon Analytics SOW 14 - Current Signed Copy

## Header

Customer: Beacon Analytics.

Statement of Work: SOW-14, signed 2026-04-03.

Effective date: 2026-04-05.

The current signed copy replaces the February draft and the generic services
template.

## Included Scope

The implementation package includes data connector setup, one sandbox
environment, and up to 40 implementation support hours.

The included support hours are for configuration, onboarding calls, and launch
questions directly tied to the signed implementation package.

Additional reporting dashboard design is not included in the fixed fee.

## Change Control

Any work outside Included Scope requires a written change order signed by both
parties before work begins.

Verbal approval in a meeting note does not amend this SOW.

Out-of-scope services are billed at $180 per hour after a signed change order is
received.

## Commercial Limits

Fixed implementation fee: $18,000.

Included implementation support hours: 40.

Unused support hours expire at launch and cannot be converted to dashboard
design services.
